rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for goods or shopping that are duty-free.

example.english: The handbags in this shop are duty-free.
example.traditional: 呢間舖頭啲手袋係免稅㗎。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau4 di1 sau2 doi6 hai6 min5 seoi3 gaa3

rows.note: Use this when you specifically mean exemption from customs duty rather than taxes generally.

example.english: This shipment is duty-free, so we do not have to pay customs duty when it enters the country.
example.traditional: 呢批貨免關稅，入境嗰陣唔使交關稅。
example.jyutping: ni1 pai1 fo3 min5 gwaan1 seoi3 jap6 ging2 go2 zan6 m4 sai2 gaau1 gwaan1 seoi3
